name: HYSPEC CHEMICALS PRIVATE LIMITED
india_angle: Hyspec Chemicals is building India's electronic chemicals platform with a focus on ultra-high-purity chemicals for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Hyspec Chemicals Private Limited specializes in developing ultra-high-purity electronic chemicals for semiconductor, solar, and advanced electronics manufacturing. Their flagship products include Ultra-Pure Dilute Hydrofluoric Acid and Anhydrous Hydrofluoric Acid, which are integral to semiconductor fabrication processes.
